name: t-stack
description: Run a software factory on sfora: a PM agent plans missions as cards, leads run teammates, every card is reviewed with proof, decisions go to the human as asks, merges are deploy-safe and production is measured. Plus the coding craft and the principles behind it.

interface.shortDescription: Run a software factory on sfora
interface.longDescription: Plan missions as cards, lead a card with teammates, hand over with proof, review by scratch copy and mutants, merge deploy-safely, verify production, and brief the owner, all in sfora. Includes the coding craft (architect, TDD, writing) and the principles the t-stack runs on.
defaultPrompt: Plan this as a sfora mission.
